summary: Frontend-only regression and redesign test of the DataKat /login and /app pages in preview mode. Seven Playwright runs against the public URL; no failing checks. REGRESSION: auth gate passes; login 401, 429 (button disabled) and network messages pass. Canonical success passes (Charlie 580, 0.10, 3 customers, '3 rows returned', Export disabled with 'Not available yet'). All 21 query scenarios show the correct card and title. Clarification fill passes: no send, 'In draft' marker, caret now at the end, replace dialog with Keep/Replace. Edit question and Review and retry fill the composer without sending. 401 restores the draft for the same email only, with the restore notice. 403 and 403-source-removed pass (composer disabled, 'This data source is no longer available.'). 429 countdown passes. Long-wait messages appear at 15s/45s, the pending draft is kept, and New analysis is disabled while pending. Inactivity notice, New analysis confirm, Shift+Enter, whitespace block and the 8000 limit pass. Sign-out works on desktop and mobile; sign-out failure shows its message. Data-source states none/multiple/failure/long-name/single pass. No topology values in the DOM. SQL ABSENCE: none of the 9 success fixtures put SELECT, View/Hide/Copy SQL or 'SQL used for this result' in the DOM or the aria snapshot, and the Preview tools panel shows no SQL. queryContract still checks that sql is a string but drops it. REDESIGN: empty-state layout order is correct. The same composer element stays focused after send. Identity rows ('DataKat' + source) show on pending and on every completed response type. Composer idle box is 66px, multiline caps at 226px then scrolls, Send is 44x44 with aria-label 'Send' and disabled when empty or pending. 'Follow-up' and 'Clarification' labels are correct. Preview sheet is closed by default and opens from the desktop, mobile and login triggers. RESPONSIVE: at all 8 viewports scrollWidth equals innerWidth, both empty and with success-20-columns (the iteration-1 overflow bug is fixed). Rail shows at >=768 with the logo only in the header; mobile header below 768. At 1280x400 the page scrolls and the composer is reachable. A11Y: skip link works, 2px #6FE7FF focus ring on buttons and the composer box, status region says 'Question sent.' and 'Result ready. 3 rows returned.', and with reduced motion getAnimations() is 0 at login, app, pending and result, with the result at opacity 1.

ui_bugs.issue: The placeholder 'Ask a question about your data…' wraps to 2 lines inside the fixed 48px textarea (scrollHeight 72), so the second line 'data…' shows cut in half under the first.

issues: Row 1 is 244px tall and rows 2-3 are 127px, with large blank space under 'Sample 1'. One long-value cell wraps heavily in a narrow column. Consider clamping long text cells (it already has View full value) or setting a min column width.
The composer is disabled, but the label still says 'Follow-up' with the hint 'Follow-ups use this analysis's context.', which is misleading when no source is available.
The 2nd interpretation shows a hard line break ('...all time,' / 'excluding cancelled orders'), probably a newline in the fixture. Check this is intended.
Radix warning 'AlertDialogContent requires a description...' is logged when the replace-draft dialog opens (aria-describedby is now undefined). Dev-only and harmless, but it can be silenced.

action_items: LOW: keep the 320px composer placeholder on one line (shorter mobile placeholder, or white-space:nowrap + text-overflow:ellipsis on ::placeholder).
LOW: when the composer is disabled because the source is unavailable, hide or adjust the Follow-up label and hint.
LOW: limit row height in wide tables (clamp long text cells).
critical_code_review_comments: queryContract.parseSuccess still requires `sql` to be a string but never forwards it. That's fine for the contract, and SQL never reaches UI state.

Preview fixtures still contain SQL strings and topology fields. They are not rendered (verified), but they ship in the dev bundle only while IS_PREVIEW is set, so make sure the preview is excluded from production builds.

success_rate.frontend: 100% of requested checks passed; 1 low-priority UI nit and 4 design notes

test_credentials: Preview mode: any email/password (analyst@example.com / secret). /app/memory/test_credentials.md exists (it still says 'Preview controls'; the button label is now 'Preview tools').
seed_data_creation: None. All data comes from preview fixtures.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Preview tools triggers: preview-indicator-tools-button (desktop header and login), mobile-preview-indicator-tools-button (<768). Close the sheet with Escape. Turn ids come from data-testid 'turn-<id>'; identity rows are 'identity-<id>' and 'identity-<id>-source'. Wait for completion with !document.querySelector('[data-testid^=pending-response-]'). Use page.locator('body').aria_snapshot() (page.accessibility is not available). Every iteration-1 issue (overflow, caret, numeric nowrap, dialog description) is verified fixed.
rca of the issue: 320px placeholder clipping: .dk-textarea has white-space:pre-wrap and its height is capped to the compact composer, so a placeholder longer than the available ~190px wraps and the second line is clipped.
